title: 6th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/1/2025).
Decentralisation Committee report on the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Government Oversight Committee report on the President's submission, under Constitution Article 116(a), of changes to the mandates of three of the ministries created on 17 November 2023.

Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations for Permanent Representatives to the International Maritime Organization, the International Renewable Energy Agency, the World Trade Organization and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation.

Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to Canada, the Arab Republic of Egypt, the Kingdom of Bhutan, the State of Kuwait and the Swiss Confederation.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to join the Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A reports-only sitting scheduled to clear five committee reports covering the Decentralisation Act amendment, ministry mandate changes, diplomatic appointments and joining the Berne copyright convention.
